name: reach-identity-check
description: Confirms that your sources are about the right person, with each source tested for same name and same organisation, namesakes set aside, the role confirmed or changed and a verdict of confirmed or not confirmed. Use for "run reach-identity-check", "identity check", "is this the right person", "same name different person", "check for a namesake", "confirm who this is", "is this source about them", "which one is the right person", part of the Claude Guide for Outreach Pack by 90n.
